title: What composing knots like cycles forces
claim: (1) The naive converse of the difference-law theorem is false: parity on {0,1} beside x<=y on {2,3} composes knots like cycles and parity beside an isolated-value relation on {2,3,4} composes all circuits like cycles, yet neither has a Mal'tsev polymorphism. (2) A knot whose fibres pairwise meet at some variable, or that has a selector, forms a hub with a copy of itself. (3) In a law composing knots like cycles, every knot on one two-element range is a single parity. (4) If every knot of a law is rectangular, the law composes knots like cycles exactly when no two knots meeting at a variable induce fibre partitions whose composition is total; no Mal'tsev operation is needed. Open: whether composing knots like cycles forces every knot to be rectangular; every 3-variable knot tested on 2, 3 and 4 values gives a hub directly or through the diagonal derivation exists h: K(x0,x0,h) and K(x1,x2,h).
failure_conditions: A system over the disjoint-union laws fails at the stated level, does not split, or a Mal'tsev operation preserves the second relation on its range.
A knot with pairwise meeting fibres or a selector does not form a hub with its copy.
An affine Boolean knot is not a single parity, or a non-affine Boolean knot's law has no hub between knots.
Under rectangular knots, a failure comes without a pair of knots whose partitions compose to the total relation, or such a pair does not fail when joined alone.
A tested knot with neither direct case is not resolved by the diagonal derivation.
A control ('no failure implies Mal'tsev', 'every knot is rectangular', 'the direct cases cover every non-rectangular knot') is accepted.
foundation_claim_scope: What a law must satisfy for its knots to compose like cycles. No native recurrence, composed topology in the protected sense, path, metric, space or physical claim.

validation.status: checked: prose proof; check.py verifies the disjoint unions on 910 random mixed systems with exhaustive Mal'tsev searches, the direct-hub lemma on 959 knots, the two-valued theorem on all Boolean knots of 3 and 4 variables, Theorem 4 on random cosets of four groups, NAE's selector, the diagonal derivation on 52 knots with neither direct case over 2, 3 and 4 values, and agreement with the census; three controls rejected; no human or external review
validation.level: V1 prose proof with exhaustive and randomized checks; builds on KNOT-CIRCUITS-20261020-001B-P001 and MALTSEV-CONVERSE-20261020-001A-E001; no trusted kernel.
validation.novelty: candidate-local-delta: elementary consequences of KNOT-CIRCUITS-20261020-001B-P001; the reduction of the converse to rectangularity of knots, the counterexamples and the diagonal-derivation observation are new to the program; the local converse is open.
